{{Short description|British entomologist (1920–2007)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Richard Gareth Davies''' (20 June 1920 – 3 September 2007) was a British [[entomologist]] and one-time professor of entomology at [[Imperial College]],<ref>{{Cite book |last=Richards |first=O.W. |last2=Davies |first2=R.G. |year=1977 |title=Imms' general textbook of entomology |edition=10th |publication-place=London |publisher=Chapman & Hall |isbn=978-0-412-15210-8 |name-list-style=amp }}</ref> at that time a constituent college of the federal [[University of London]].<ref>{{cite book|title=Who's Who of British Scientists 1980/81|date=1980|publisher=Simon Books Limited|isbn=0862290015|page=121|edition=3rd}}</ref> He died on 3 September 2007, at the age of 87.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Quartau |first1=J. A. |title=Personal recollections of Richard Gareth Davies (20 June 1920 to 3 September 2007), an outstanding entomologist, with a summary of his curriculum vitae and publications |journal=The Entomologist |date=July 2025 |volume=161 |issue=3 |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/394132384_Personal_recollections_of_Richard_Gareth_Davies_20_June_1920_to_3_September_2007_an_outstanding_entomologist_with_a_summary_of_his_curriculum_vitae_and_publications |access-date=3 January 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Richard Gareth Davies b. 1920 |url=https://www.gro.gov.uk/gro/content/certificates/indexes_search.asp#Results |website=GRO Index |access-date=3 January 2026}}</ref>

==Publications==
In 1925, [[Augustus Daniel Imms]] published the first edition of ''A General Textbook of Entomology''.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Imms |first=A.D. |year=1925 |title=A general textbook of entomology, including the anatomy, physiology, development and classification of insects |publication-place=London |publisher=Methuen |oclc=5785869 }}</ref> Its seventh edition appeared in 1948, the year before his death. By then it had become one of the standard entomological textbooks of its day; in 1958 it was described as having been "the standard reference work for over 30 years".<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Varley |first=G.C. |year=1958 |title=An Entomological Classic |journal=Journal of Animal Ecology |volume=27 |issue=1 |pages=162–163 |doi=10.2307/2182 |jstor=2182 }}</ref> In 1942, Imms published a shorter, simpler version, ''Outlines of Entomology''.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Imms |first=A.D. |author-link=Augustus Daniel Imms |year=1942 |title=Outlines of Entomology |publication-place=London |publisher=Methuen |oclc=899090299 }}</ref> Further editions of both books were published up to the time of Imms' death in 1949,<ref>{{Cite journal | doi = 10.1038/156712a0 | title = Dr. A. D. Imms, F.R.S | journal = Nature | volume = 156 | issue = 3972 | page = 712| year = 1945 | doi-access = free }}</ref> the main textbook reaching the 7th edition,<ref>{{Cite book |last=Imms |first=A.D. |year=1948 |title=A general textbook of entomology, including the anatomy, physiology, development and classification of insects |edition=7th |publication-place=London |publisher=Methuen |oclc=875399017 }}</ref> the shorter version the 4th.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Imms |first=A.D. |year=1949 |title=Outlines of Entomology |edition=4th |publication-place=London |publisher=Methuen |oclc=3522225 }}</ref>

After Imms' death, [[Owain Richards]] and Davies took on the task of keeping Imms' works up to date. Later editions were published as ''Imm's General Textbook of Entomology'' and ''Imm's Outlines of Entomology'', with Richards and Davies given on the cover as the authors. The final 10th edition of the general textbook appeared in 1977.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Richards |first=O.W. |last2=Davies |first2=R.G. |year=1977 |title=Imms' general textbook of entomology |edition=10th |publication-place=London |publisher=Chapman & Hall |isbn=978-0-412-15210-8 |name-list-style=amp }}</ref> It still is sufficiently significant to have been reprinted (in two softcover volumes).<ref>Imms' General Textbook of Entomology: Volume I: Structure, Physiology and Development (Science Paperbacks) Paperback – November 10, 1977 by A.D. Imms (Editor), O.W. Richards (Editor), R.G. Davies (Editor) 10th ed {{ISBN|978-0412152108}} and Vol 2,  November 28, 2014 {{ISBN|978-9401704748}} Pub. Springer</ref>

Davies' other publications include:
*''Computer Programming in Quantitative Biology'' 1971. Published by Academic Press. {{ISBN|978-0122062506}}
